svg.title: Routes of vertical infection
svg.desc: When and how infections pass from mother to child. Before birth, across the placenta: cytomegalovirus, toxoplasma, syphilis and parvovirus B19. During birth, from the birth canal and blood: group B streptococcus, herpes simplex virus, HIV and hepatitis B. After birth, through breast milk: HIV and cytomegalovirus.
